intro.title: Why Is Office Space Essential for Business Setup?
intro.paragraph1: The modern business centers of Dubai and the UAE rank among the most vibrant in the world! Beyond licenses and visas, having a professional office space is the cornerstone of business presence.
intro.paragraph2: For most trade and professional licenses, a registered office address is legally required — and it enhances your company's credibility. When clients, investors, and authorities look at your business, a proper office reinforces your stability and professionalism.
intro.paragraph3: Whether it's a flexi desk, a serviced office, or a corporate HQ — the choice of office solution has a direct link to your efficiency, costs, and long-term success.

officeTypesSection.title: What Types of Office Spaces Are Available?
officeTypesSection.subtitle: Swipe through 6 premium office solutions — from affordable desks to full corporate HQ.

items.title: Flexi Desk (Hot Desk)
items.description: A flexi desk is the most affordable office option in Dubai, ideal for startups, freelancers, and solo entrepreneurs. It provides a shared workstation, trade license, business address, and access to reception, common areas, and meeting rooms — without the high costs of a full office.

items.title: Dedicated Desk
items.description: A dedicated desk offers a permanent, private workspace in a shared office — ideal for those needing consistency and privacy. Unlike hot desks, it's your personal setup to organize as you like. Includes mail handling, utilities, and office amenities.

items.title: Private Offices
items.description: A private office offers SMEs and growing businesses a fully enclosed, furnished space with full privacy and control. Ideal for branding, client meetings, and professional operations with an upscale address in premium business towers.

items.title: Serviced Offices
items.description: Serviced offices are fully equipped, ready-to-use workspaces that cover all your business needs — from reception and high-speed internet to meeting rooms, cleaning, and utilities. Save time and setup costs while focusing on growth.

items.title: Coworking Areas
items.description: Coworking areas are vibrant, modern spaces designed for collaboration, networking, and innovation. Ideal for freelancers, startups, and digital entrepreneurs, offering flexible memberships, quality infrastructure, and a creative environment.

items.title: Commercial Leased Offices
items.description: Commercially leased offices are ideal for corporates and multinationals seeking long-term space in prime areas like Business Bay, DIFC, Sheikh Zayed Road, and JLT. Fully customizable with branding and layout options.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Office Space Solutions. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.q: What type of office space is offered in Dubai and the UAE?
items.a: Depending on your business size, budget, and license requirements, you can select from flexi desks, dedicated desks, private offices, serviced offices, coworking spaces, or long-term commercial leased office space.

items.q: Do I need an office to obtain a business license in Dubai?
items.a: Yes. Every business license in Dubai requires an official registered address or Ejari. Free zone licenses have the option of flexi-desk packages that provide a business address without a physical office.

items.q: What is the difference between a flexi desk and a dedicated desk?
items.a: A flexi desk (hot desk) is a shared workstation you use as available, best for freelancers. A dedicated desk is your own permanent desk in a shared office, offering consistency and privacy.

items.q: Can I upgrade my office space as my company grows?
items.a: Absolutely. We offer scalable solutions — start with a flexi desk or coworking membership, then seamlessly upgrade to a private office or commercial space as your business grows.

items.q: Are utilities and internet included in office packages?
items.a: Yes. Most of our serviced office and coworking packages include utilities, high-speed internet, reception, cleaning, and access to meeting rooms — all in one monthly fee.

items.q: What locations are best suited for renting an office in Dubai?
items.a: It depends on your business type. Business Bay and DIFC for corporate, Downtown for prestige, JLT for affordability, Dubai Marina for creative/tech, and Free Zones for trade and international businesses.

items.q: How much does office space in Dubai cost?
items.a: Costs range from affordable flexi desks (starting around AED 5,000/year) to premium private offices and commercial spaces. We match you with options that fit your budget.

items.q: Can I share offices with another company?
items.a: Yes. Coworking spaces and shared offices allow you to share common areas with other businesses, while keeping your own dedicated workspace and address.

items.q: What is the usual time taken to set up an office space in Dubai?
items.a: Typically 2-5 working days for flexi desks and serviced offices. Commercial leased offices and custom fit-outs may take longer depending on requirements.

items.q: What are the benefits of using Setup Zone Dubai for my office space needs?
items.a: We offer transparent pricing, direct stakeholder access, end-to-end contract drafting, Ejari registration, ongoing renewals and authority approvals, and scalable packages tailored to your business.
